name: Durable Identity
summary: Describes whether the ceremony has resolved to a canonical AppUser.

values.name: Absent
values.summary: No durable user has been resolved.

values.name: Existing
values.summary: An existing durable user has been selected.

values.name: Creation Required
values.summary: A new durable user must be created after remaining requirements are satisfied.

values.name: Resolved
values.summary: A canonical durable user is established.

values.name: Conflict
values.summary: Resolution is ambiguous or conflicts with an existing identity.
